query: What is the name of the actress who has received a Drama Desk award and was part of the cast album for the 2007 Broadway production of the hit musical, "Grease"?

pipeline_result.response: Laura Osnes. She received a Drama Desk Award for her performance in the Broadway cast recording of "Grease". Laura Osnes is an actress who has performed in various Broadway productions and has been recognized with nominations for her work, including a Drama Desk Award. The 2007 Broadway cast recording of "Grease" features performances from her role as Sandy Dumbrowski.
retrieved_context: Grease: The New Broadway Cast Recording: Grease: The New Broadway Cast Recording is the cast album for the 2007 Broadway production of the hit musical, "Grease".  The show, directed by Tony Award-winner Kathleen Marshall, played at the Brooks Atkinson Theatre in New York City.  This recording features performances from the cast of "Grease" including Jenny Powers, Matthew Saldivar, and "" winners, Laura Osnes and Max Crumm as Sandy Dumbrowski and Danny Zuko, respectively.

Linda Eder: Linda Eder ( ; born February 3, 1961) is an American singer and actress.  She made her Broadway debut in the musical "Jekyll & Hyde", originating the role of Lucy, for which she was nominated for the Drama Desk Award.  Eder has performed in concert halls across the country including Carnegie Hall and Radio City Musical Hall.  She has released 15 solo albums.

Grease (film): Grease is a 1978 American musical romantic comedy film based on Jim Jacobs and Warren Casey's musical of the same name.  Written by Bronte Woodard and directed by Randal Kleiser in his theatrical feature film debut, the film depicts the life of Rydell High School students Danny (John Travolta) and Sandy (Olivia Newton-John) in the late 1950s.  "Grease" was successful both critically and commercially.  Its ended 1978 as the second-best selling album of the year in the United States, behind the of the 1977 blockbuster "Saturday Night Fever".
